title: Temperature Controlled Normalization from CSV
author: Opentrons
materials: Dispense the tip in the Trash.

steps.title: Load plates onto temperature modules
steps.instruction: Place the source 96‑well PCR plate and the destination 96‑well PCR plate onto the second‑generation temperature modules as defined in the protocol.

steps.title: Pick up tip for diluent
steps.instruction: Mount the selected pipette (P20 GEN2 or P300 GEN2) on the side (right or left) specified by its mount parameter, then pick up a fresh tip from the appropriate tip rack.

steps.title: Aspirate diluent from reservoir
steps.instruction: Aspirate the volume of diluent specified for each destination well from one of wells 1‑4 of the Nest 12‑channel 15 mL reservoir located in slot 2, using the aspiration height from the bottom of the reservoir wells (mm) parameter. Use the same tip for successive aspirates.

steps.title: Dispense diluent into destination wells
steps.instruction: Dispense the aspirated diluent into the destination 96‑well plate wells as listed in the CSV file, using the dispensing height from the bottom of the destination wells (mm) parameter. Continue until all diluent transfers are completed.

steps.title: Discard tip after diluent
steps.instruction: Eject the tip into the trash.

steps.title: Pick up tip for sample transfer
steps.instruction: Mount the appropriate pipette (use P20 for 1‑20 µL sample volumes, P300 for 1‑200 µL) on the side specified by its mount parameter, then pick up a fresh tip.

steps.title: Aspirate sample from source plate
steps.instruction: Aspirate the sample volume specified for each well from the source 96‑well plate according to the CSV, using the aspiration height from the bottom of the source plate wells (mm) parameter and applying the flow‑rate multiplier (default 0.5) to slow aspiration.

steps.title: Dispense sample into destination wells
steps.instruction: Dispense the aspirated sample into the corresponding destination well of the 96‑well plate, using the dispensing height from the bottom of the destination wells (mm) parameter.

steps.title: Discard tip after sample
steps.instruction: Eject the tip into the trash.

steps.title: Repeat diluent and sample transfers
steps.instruction: Loop through the CSV rows: for each row perform steps 2‑5 for diluent, then steps 6‑9 for the sample, until all specified wells have been processed.
